_comment: Lives on the boot media only. NEVER commit config.json. Initialize-WinPEAP.ps1 writes/merges the top keys; add the optional ones by hand and they are preserved on re-run.

_notes.Repo: owner/name of the repo (or your fork) the media pulls scripts from at runtime
_notes.Ref: branch or tag you pin to - 'main', your own 'stable', a version tag
_notes.GroupTagMenu: OPTIONAL. Omit for a plain 'Group Tag (blank = none)' prompt. Include an array of {label, tag} for a numbered menu; a 'Manual entry' option is always appended.
